Global oil prices rise amid US-Iran tensions

The global oil market is experiencing increased volatility due to the recent unraveling of a US-Iran ceasefire and rising tensions in the Middle East. This has led to concerns about supply disruptions, particularly at the strategic Hormuz Strait. As a result, oil prices have risen, with Brent crude topping $90 per barrel. The situation highlights the potential impact of global events on energy markets.
